data.name: Fake Hero
data.detailed_description:
Who Says Heroes Have to Look Heroic?

Play as a cast of unconventional “heroes,” each with their own unique abilities, and take on endless waves of monsters. Weave through hordes of enemies, dodge attacks by a hair, and unleash everything you’ve got as the battle grows ever more intense. Defeat powerful foes along the way, fight your way to the Moon, and take down the ultimate boss waiting there!

Go It Alone or Fight Alongside Friends

Embark on the adventure solo, or team up with as many as three friends. Choose different characters and combine their unique combat abilities to support one another amid the chaos as you face increasingly ferocious waves of monsters together.

Combine Items, Skills, and Talents to Create Your Own Build

Collect items with a wide range of effects, learn new skills, and choose talents that transform the way you fight. Mix, match, and upgrade your abilities to create a build that’s uniquely yours. Chain attacks together, stack effects upon effects, and grow from barely surviving into an unstoppable monster-clearing machine!
